thread.title: Tech sector hits record as Google parent sees best session since Oct. 2015 - MarketWatch

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: Tech sector hits record as Google parent sees best session since Oct. 2015 - MarketWatch
text: The technology sector hit a record high in early trading on Tuesday, supported by a better-than-expected quarterly earnings report from Alphabet, the parent company of Google. The sector rose 1.2%, extending its year-to-date advance to 17.5%. Alphabet GOOGL, +4.61% climbed 4.8%, on track for its biggest one-day percentage gain since October 2015. The search giant hit a record of its own, supported by results that came in much stronger than had been anticipated . The stock is up more than 20% thus far this year. Among other notable technology names, Facebook Inc. FB, +2.04% jumped 2.1% and hit an all-time high, while Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.81% was up 0.8%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.89% rose 0.5% while the S&P 500 SPX, +0.76% was up 0.7%. The Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +0.85% climbed 1.1% and hit record levels. The Nasdaq 100 NDX, +1.18% jumped 1.3% and hit record levels.
